brief: Chicago white granite pinstriped tube with four notched solid corners, full-height V piers, tall glass lobby, mapped roof plant and current eastern broadcast mast.

sourceFacts.currentCladding: White granite replacing the original Carrara marble

reconstruction.plan: Signed exact outline with separate32 m roof service block
reconstruction.facade: Four principal V-pier faces with white solid notched corner returns; merged glazed planes and strip frames
reconstruction.heightDatum: 340m main roof,346.3m architectural plant and362.5m functional mast

limitations: Original 168138-triangle/17479792-byte master remains exactly reproducible from the unchanged global recipe. Reviewed source keeps the signed notched tower and separate roof plant, corrects the corner returns to broad solid granite surfaces, retains full-height V-faced granite piers down through the tall lobby and adds the photo-supported eastern roof antenna to published362.5 m tip. Published architectural346.3 m/occupied328 m/83floors/1973/recladding1992 from CVU. Main roof340 m, lobby10.4 m,15bays per long face, pier half-width.69 m/depth.58 m, glazing/floor pitch,8 m south/12 m east antenna offset, antenna diameter/supports and service forms are reconstructed, not measured construction dimensions. Full vertical glass planes and long frame/spandrel strips replace per-window frame geometry; distant levels aggregate horizontal coverage. Stone grain uses canonical shared granite; no tiny joint geometry or copied facade photo. Three shared256px concrete/granite/painted-metal graphs and opaque palette glass, zero embedded images. Two-level landscaped sunken plaza, fountains/sculptures, subterranean garage/pedways, lobby interiors, detailed doors, flags/lettering, minor rooftop aerials and proposed observation-deck/elevator alterations excluded. Ground-contact shell has no terrain-grade proof. Physical phones/laptops and dense-city timing remain unmeasured. Cached Los Angeles Aon photos/brochure explicitly rejected; they do not inform this model.
